items.question: Does the camera viewpoint remain steadily at a nearby observer position throughout the video without abrupt shifts or jumps?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，摄像机视角是否始终稳定地保持在附近观察者的位置，不发生突然的移动或跳动？

items.question: Does the magnetic stirrer continue to operate in the glass beaker throughout the entire procedure?
items.question_zh: 在整个操作过程中，磁力搅拌器是否在玻璃烧杯中持续运转？

items.question: Does the small brown glass bottle remain a single, intact, identifiable bottle for the entire video?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，棕色小玻璃瓶是否始终是单一、完整、可辨识的瓶子？

items.question: Does the micropipette retrieved from the stand remain one continuous identifiable object after the fresh tip is attached (no splitting, duplication, or morphing)?
items.question_zh: 从支架上取下的微量移液器在装上新的吸头之后，是否始终是同一个连续可辨识的对象（不发生分裂、复制或变形）？

items.question: Does the right hand unscrew and remove the white cap from the brown bottle, exposing its opening?
items.question_zh: 右手是否拧下并取下棕色瓶子上的白色瓶盖，露出瓶口？

items.question: Does the right hand set the white cap aside onto the benchtop?
items.question_zh: 右手是否将白色瓶盖放到一旁的工作台台面上？

items.question: Does the right hand reach to the PBS bottle and unscrew its cap?
items.question_zh: 右手是否伸向 PBS 瓶并拧下它的瓶盖？

items.question: Does the right hand retrieve the untipped micropipette from the pipette stand?
items.question_zh: 右手是否从移液器支架上取下未装吸头的微量移液器？

items.question: Does the operator open the pipette tip box?
items.question_zh: 操作者是否打开了移液器吸头盒？

items.question: Does the operator press the micropipette into a fresh tip so that the tip becomes attached?
items.question_zh: 操作者是否将微量移液器按压到一个新吸头上，使吸头被装上？

items.question: Is the fresh pipette tip visibly attached to the micropipette before the pipette tip enters the PBS bottle?
items.question_zh: 在移液器吸头进入 PBS 瓶之前，新的吸头是否可见地安装在微量移液器上？

items.question: Does the pipette with the attached tip enter the opening of the PBS bottle?
items.question_zh: 装上吸头的移液器是否进入 PBS 瓶的瓶口？

items.question: Does the operator draw PBS liquid up into the pipette tip (visible liquid rising)?
items.question_zh: 操作者是否将 PBS 液体吸入移液器吸头（可见液面上升）？

items.question: Does the operator move the pipette from the PBS bottle to a position directly above the open brown bottle?
items.question_zh: 操作者是否将移液器从 PBS 瓶移到敞开的棕色瓶的正上方位置？

items.question: Does the operator dispense the PBS liquid from the pipette into the open brown bottle?
items.question_zh: 操作者是否将 PBS 液体从移液器中排出，注入敞开的棕色瓶中？

items.question: At the end of the video, is the transferred PBS liquid visibly present inside the brown bottle (e.g., increased liquid volume)?
items.question_zh: 在视频结尾，转移到棕色瓶中的 PBS 液体是否可见地存在（例如液体体积增加）？

items.question: Does the pipette tip enter the PBS bottle through its opening without clipping through the bottle walls?
items.question_zh: 移液器吸头是否从 PBS 瓶的瓶口进入，而没有穿透过瓶壁？

items.question: Does the aspirated PBS liquid remain inside the pipette tip during transit to the brown bottle without leaking or dripping?
items.question_zh: 在移向棕色瓶的过程中，吸入的 PBS 液体是否始终留在移液器吸头内，不发生渗漏或滴落？

items.question: Does the procedure avoid unintended spillage of PBS or other liquid onto the benchtop or the operator's gloves?
items.question_zh: 操作是否避免了 PBS 或其他液体意外洒落到工作台台面或操作者的手套上？

items.question: Do the glass containers (the brown bottle and the glass beaker) remain intact without breakage throughout the video?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，玻璃容器（棕色瓶和玻璃烧杯）是否保持完好，不发生破损？
